Package org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api.cee

package org.cha0scollective.wwpg.api.cee
CEE 1.1.3-specific adapters for WWPG API 1.0. This optional developer artifact is separate from the platform-independent API and requires the pinned CEE API. Adapter parameters retain CEE's native source conventions; WWPG performs the translation to PG. No PG objects, graph ordinals, or solver arrays are public.
